# Typography

원티드 시스템의 기본적인 타이포 시스템입니다.

`Typography` 컴포넌트로 사용할 수 있습니다.

## 목록

<Demo 
  hideCode
  code={`import { FlexBox, Grid, GridItem, Typography } from '@wanteddev/wds';

const variants = [
  'display1',
  'display2',
  'title1',
  'title2',
  'title3',
  'heading1',
  'heading2',
  'headline1',
  'headline2',
  'body1',
  'body1-reading',
  'body2',
  'body2-reading',
  'label1',
  'label1-reading',
  'label2',
  'caption1',
  'caption2',
];
const weights = ['regular', 'medium', 'bold'];


const Demo = () => {
  return (
    <FlexBox flexDirection="column" gap="8px">
      {variants.map((variant) => (
        <Grid
          spacing={4}
          md={{ spacing: 10 }}
          key={variant}
        >
          <GridItem columns>
            <Typography variant="label1" color="palette.label.alternative" weight="regular">
              {variant}
            </Typography>
          </GridItem>
          {weights.map((weight) => (
            <GridItem key={variant + weight} columns={12} md={{ columns: 3 }}>
              <Typography variant={variant} weight={weight}>
                원티드
              </Typography>
            </GridItem>
          ))}
        </Grid>
      ))}
    </FlexBox>
  )
}

export default Demo;`}
/>
